description: This file contains utility functions for the JMESPath PHP implementation, including type determination, object/array checks, comparison, sorting, and slicing.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for type checking, comparison, sorting, and slicing relevant to JMESPath processing.

methods.name: isTruthy
methods.description: Checks if a value is considered 'truthy' in JMESPath context, accounting for zero, '0', and object types.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Determines the JMESPath type equivalent of a PHP variable, handling arrays, objects, and closures.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a JMESPath-compatible object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if a value is a JMESPath-compatible array.

methods.name: isEqual
methods.description: Performs a JSON-aware comparison between two values.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Safely adds two values, handling different data types.

methods.name: stableSort
methods.description: Performs a stable sort on an array using a custom comparison function, implementing Schwartzian transform.

methods.name: slice
methods.description: Creates a slice of an array or string, similar to Python's slice syntax.
